description: Source code for the 'procfs' package providing process information utilities, including process listing, command line, memory, and file descriptor details.

classes.name: Proc
classes.description: Represents a process with methods to retrieve process-specific information.

methods.name: Self
methods.description: Returns a Proc object for the current process.

methods.name: NewProc
methods.description: Creates a Proc object for a given PID.

methods.name: AllProcs
methods.description: Returns a list of all current processes.

methods.name: CmdLine
methods.description: Retrieves the command line arguments of the process.

methods.name: Wchan
methods.description: Returns the wait channel of the process.

methods.name: Comm
methods.description: Returns the command name of the process.

methods.name: Executable
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the process's executable.

methods.name: Cwd
methods.description: Returns the current working directory of the process.

methods.name: RootDir
methods.description: Returns the root directory of the process.

methods.name: FileDescriptors
methods.description: Returns open file descriptors of the process.

methods.name: FileDescriptorTargets
methods.description: Returns targets of all file descriptors.

methods.name: FileDescriptorsLen
methods.description: Returns the number of open file descriptors.

methods.name: MountStats
methods.description: Retrieves mount statistics for the process.

methods.name: MountInfo
methods.description: Retrieves mount information for the process.

methods.name: FileDescriptorsInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about all file descriptors.

methods.name: Schedstat
methods.description: Returns scheduling info for the process.
